name: GitLab repository native route structural closure (CHAOS-3342)

mutations.rationale: the fetched GitLab project must be the exact numeric project id claimed by the leased provider unit; accepting another project would persist data outside the claimed source scope
ClickHouse stores DateTime64(3); retaining finer precision changes effect identity and makes post-write readback disagree with the persisted row
the instance discriminator must use the production Python normalizer's scheme-qualified representation or self-managed project ids can compare against the wrong scope
repository ids are provider-derived and can collide across organizations; recovery must inspect the exact tenant key or one tenant's row can authorize another tenant's effect

mutations.find:
case provider == "gitlab" && dataset == "repo-metadata":
		descriptor.Destinations = []string{"repos"}
		descriptor.RouteReady = true
		descriptor.RouteEnabled = switches.GitlabRepoMetadata
mutations.replace:
case provider == "gitlab" && dataset == "repo-metadata":
		descriptor.Destinations = []string{"repos"}
		descriptor.RouteReady = false
		descriptor.RouteEnabled = switches.GitlabRepoMetadata
mutations.rationale: the completed pair must be represented by the canonical descriptor consumed by routing and the checked-in matrix; dead handler code is not a port
